article: The Macedonian IGL will lead the organization's international transition.
Update 15:00 : This article was updated after Aurora announced the signing of Damjan "⁠kyxsan⁠" Stoilkovski from Falcons .
Aurora have announced the signing of kyxsan from Falcons to complete their summer rebuild with a new international IGL.

The move for the Macedonian in-game-leader follows the additions of Jimi "⁠Jimpphat⁠" Salo and Ashley "⁠ash⁠" Battye earlier on Friday, with the new trio replacing Engin "⁠MAJ3R⁠" Küpeli , Caner "⁠soulfly⁠" Kesici , and Sezgin "⁠Fabre⁠" Kalaycı .

kyxsan joins the team from Falcons , who he led from January 2025 to April 2026 and notably won PGL Bucharest with the squad, before he was benched for Finn "⁠karrigan⁠" Andersen ahead of the IEM Cologne Major.
The new international Aurora will debut at BLAST Bounty 2026 Season 2, set to begin on July 21 with the online stage.
Ismailcan "⁠XANTARES⁠" Dörtkardeş Özgür "⁠woxic⁠" Eker Ali "⁠Wicadia⁠" Haydar Yalçın Jimi "⁠Jimpphat⁠" Salo Damjan "⁠kyxsan⁠" Stoilkovski
